registration.status: Implementation prepared; awaiting explicit user start. No paid model/search call has been sent.
registration.mainline: Execution experience for predicting the value of a specific next search.
registration.classification: New prospective bounded-reward supplement; source-only curation is performed before predictions/outcomes.
registration.selection: Fixed shuffled rank; official set-answer, single-line references. Require two Flash annotation checks and a natural pending query after exactly one completed search. Take first128 valid states. Keep all rejections and early finishes.
registration.source_population: Flash-origin pending-query states; natural early answers excluded and reported.
registration.branch_contract: Preserve the complete pending tool call. STOP returns an explicit cancellation tool response; SAME/SWITCH execute that fixed query once then finish. All branches receive8192 completion tokens. The shared prefix/query planning cost is recorded separately and retained for end-to-end accounting.
registration.search_contract: Five snippets, at most1500 characters each; matching output schema, no implicit page fetch. Same exact query and endpoint parameters share a saved response across stochastic actor draws. Report filtered benchmark-answer URLs.
registration.primary_endpoint: F1 against question-granularity, pre-execution frozen canonical items and aliases. This is benchmark set agreement, not an assertion of world-complete recall. Two Flash reviews are secondary and do not form independent-model validation.
registration.primary_comparison: Mean SAME-minus-STOP and SWITCH-minus-STOP gain risk: direct query-aware gain regression versus the per-action development mean; paired component95% interval.
secondary: query-aware versus query-hidden raw and calibrated forecasts
cost at0,.001,.005,.01,.02 per1000 reported model tokens; search attempts and rates reported separately
registration.model_selection: Four development component folds; penalties0.01,0.1,1,10,100; compare constant guard. No target test outcome or held-out search result used in selection.
registration.timing: Freeze source annotations and task split; extract only already observed document entities; freeze all raw forecasts before development actors. Freeze fitted test predictions before test actors.
registration.split: Tasks and connected components of observed prefix URLs or shared reference entities stay together. Development requires at least four components; any eligibility/split deficit stops before actor outcomes.

budget.includes: Every physical HTTP attempt, including retries, screening, extraction, forecasts and answer reviews.
budget.priority: Complete the fixed primary frame and deterministic scoring before optional secondary answer reviews.

registration.measurement: Repeated draws and answer items do not increase independent task N. Preserve terminal failures at zero, transport missingness and shared response/answer identities.
registration.uncertainty: 10000 observed-component bootstrap samples; simple zero-projection is separate from secondary ambiguous-label bounds.
registration.stop: Stop for incomplete eligibility/frame, exhausted budget, repeated transport failure, or inability to split components. Retain results without selecting a favorable subset.
implemented_baselines: direct gain versions of each feature family
learned outcome level plus mean gain
registration.reference_note: Canonical strings and aliases are copied from exact spans of the official reference, then separately checked by Flash before cohort selection. Primary scoring is fixed set agreement; this curation is not independent verification of every world fact.
registration.inference_cost_note: Models selected as constants by development CV can omit per-query feature extraction and forecasts. End-to-end model-token totals also include the common prefix.
registration.user_constraint: Develop and test only, stop before real execution. All planned model calls use Flash; total model+search attempts <=8000 including retries.
registration.prediction_encoding: Direct gain methods encode STOP=0 and the two relative gains; these are not absolute expected-F1 predictions. Outcome MSE is omitted for them; routing uses differences.
registration.secondary_review_policy: Deduplicate identical task/answer sets. One Flash review each, plus a second review for every fifth case and ambiguous first reviews. The3072-call entry is a conservative upper bound, not a spending target.

finalization_revision_before_test.stage: Development-only engineering output pilot; no test outputs or fitted test predictions existed.
finalization_revision_before_test.reason: Auto tool choice emitted unprovided search calls during required finalization.
finalization_revision_before_test.new_contract: Keep enabled reasoning and tools context, set tool_choice none and response_format json_object for the one final answer call. Preserve legal canceled/completed tool response.
finalization_revision_before_test.forecast_action: Regenerate both raw forecaster views with the explicit revised final-delivery definition before every fresh formal actor output.
finalization_revision_before_test.preservation: engineering_before_json_delivery plus unchanged old llm/forecast files. All requests remain in the same capped ledger.

primary.comparison: query-aware direct gain regression minus per-action development mean; mean of two gain risks

strict_measurement: F1 against curated original-reference spans and frozen aliases. This is an adapted objective identity layer, not the official Gemini autorater or world-complete factual verification.
input_boundary: Predict from input only. Component IDs, rewards, development means and costs belong to the evaluator.
engineering_history: The pre-JSON-finalization development pilot is preserved separately and excluded from this formal frame. All requests remain in the campaign budget ledger.
